text:
```yaml
name: PR CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Upgrade dependencies
        run: npm update --save-dev

      - name: Run linting
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./coverage

      - name: Autofix formatting/lint issues
        uses: autofix-ci/action@635ffb0c9798bd160680f18fd73371e355b85f27
        with:
          fail-fast: true
          commit-message: "chore(pr): autoformat and lint"
          comment: "Automatically fixed formatting and lint issues"

      - name: Track workflow duration in PostHog
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0ee0b44d7b152869e6840
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: "PR CI Workflow"
          properties: '{"repository": "${{ github.repository }}", "branch": "${{ github.ref_name }}"'
          capture-run-duration: true
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Publish CI results to Testspace
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: "your-testspace-domain.com"
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}
          config-args: "--config-file .testspace.yml"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow is designed to run on every pull request targeting the `main` branch. It includes steps to check out the code, set up Node.js, upgrade dependencies, run linting, execute tests, upload test coverage to Codecov, automatically fix formatting and lint issues, track the workflow duration using PostHog, and publish CI results to Testspace. Make sure to replace placeholders like `your-testspace-domain.com`, `${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}`, and `${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}` with actual values or secrets as needed.
